headline: Accepted $20,000 Cummings Foundation gift for Bates Elementary and adopted revised physical restraint policy.
summary: Officials gave back-to-school updates, including traffic and crossing guard plans near Sarah Parker Remond School. Members also approved a 2026-2028 school physician contract and revised 2026-2027 calendars for three Salem schools. Wellness, medication, and policy manual Section B were adopted for first reading.
decisions: Approved the consent agenda, with 6 votes in favor and 1 absent.
Accepted the $20,000 donation from the Cummings Foundation for Bates Elementary School, unanimously.
Approved the school physician contract for 2026-2028, unanimously.
Declared Salem High School books and instructional materials as surplus, unanimously.
Adopted the revised 2026-2027 calendars for Salem High School, New Liberty Innovation School and Salem Prep High School, unanimously.
Suspended three readings of revised or new policies so the revised Physical Restraint Policy 5416 could be adopted immediately, unanimously.
Adopted the revised Physical Restraint Policy 5416 immediately, unanimously.
Adopted the revised Wellness Policy 5711/ADF for first reading, unanimously.
Adopted the revised Medication Administration Policy 5709 for first reading, unanimously.
Adopted Section B of the Policy Manual for first reading, with implementation held until the full manual review is complete, unanimously.

decision_evidence.quote: Member Stott made a motion to approve the consent agenda. Member Manning seconded. Motion passed with 6 votes in favor and 1 absent.
Member Hoffman made a motion to accept the donation from the Cummings Foundation. Member Stott seconded and it was so VOTED. Motion passed unanimously.
Member Hoffman made a motion to approve the school physician contract for 2026-2028. Member Miranda seconded and it was so VOTED. Motion passed unanimously.
Member Miranda made a motion to declare the Salem High School books and instructional materials as surplus. Member Byas seconded and it was so VOTED. Motion passed unanimously.

Member Stott made a motion to adopt the revised Salem High School, New Liberty Innovation School and Salem Prep High School 2026-2027 calendars. Member Miranda seconded and it was so VOTED. Motion passed unanimously.

Member Miranda made a motion to temporarily suspend three readings of revised or new policies in order for immediate adoption of the revised Physical Restraint Policy 5416. Member Hoffman seconded and it was so VOTED. Motion passed unanimously.
Member Miranda made a motion for immediate adoption of the revised Physical Restraint Policy 5416. Member Manning seconded and it was so VOTED. Motion passed unanimously.
Member Miranda made a motion to adopt the revised Wellness Policy 5711/ADF for first reading. Member Hoffman seconded and it was so VOTED. Motion passed unanimously.
Member Hoffman made a motion to adopt the revised Medication Administration Policy 5709 for first reading. Member Stott seconded and it was so VOTED. Motion passed unanimously.

Member Hoffman made a motion to adopt Section B of the Policy Manual and hold implementation of the policies until the completion of the full Policy Manual review for first reading. Member Stott seconded and it was so VOTED. Motion passed unanimously.
